## How should the actuation trade study (TS-001) weigh its twelve criteria?

`DQ-016` · reversibility **easy** · gate G2 · asked 2026-11-12

TS-001 compares centralised hydraulic, series-hybrid with electrohydraulic joints, and series-hybrid with electromechanical joints (architecture/trades/TS-001.yaml). **The weights decide the ranking once evidence is scored**, and choosing them is a value judgement for the decision authority. The draft gives the four safety-related criteria (controllability, leakage and fire, stored energy, fault response) 45 of 100 points, with fault response highest at 15; cost and power density get 10 each.

| Option | What it does and costs |
|---|---|
| **Confirm the drafted weights** (recommended) | Safety-related criteria 45 points, fault response 15, cost 10. Scoring can start as evidence arrives. |
| Weigh every criterion equally (8.33 each) | No judgement built in; safety criteria count for a third, and noise counts as much as fault response. |
| Give your own weights | Tell Claude the weights in chat; they replace the draft. |
